title: PROXYQA: An Alternative Framework for Evaluating Long-Form Text Generation with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the win rates and agreement rates of LLM evaluators (GPT-Separate and GPT-Batch) against human preferences to demonstrate that GPT-as-a-judge exhibits overconfidence and a systemic preference for content generated by its own models (e.g., GPT-4-Turbo).
